# Day 1 — Talking in Mathematics

Day 1 — Talking in Mathematics / Setup. Math covers notation, algebra
review, functions, and an introduction to limits — the foundation for
everything else in the camp. Programming covers setup (R, RStudio,
Zotero, GitHub) and the basics of the R/RStudio interface.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
